description: Traverse the knowledge graph from a seed component or page. Returns { nodes: [{ id, label, node_type }], edges: [{ source_node_id, target_node_id, edge_type }] } within a depth budget (default 2, max 4 hops). Read-only. Use to see how a component connects to the rest of the app; use get_blast_radius for a bug's impact area, or get_graph_neighborhood for a tighter BFS around one node.

depth.description: BFS hops outward from seed — clamped to 4 in the handler (default 2)

seed.description: Starting graph node id or human-readable label to traverse from

name: get_knowledge_graph

nodes.description: Graph nodes within the depth budget

title: Knowledge graph traversal
